lines.english: O Allah: You are the Lord of glory and greatness
And the Lord of magnanimity and omnipotence
And the Lord of pardon and mercy,
And the worthiest of being feared and the Lord of forgiveness;

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقّ هذَا الْيَوْمِ الّذِي جَعَلْتَهُ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ عِيداً،
lines.transliteration: as’aluka bihaqqi hadha aliyawmi alladhy ja`altahu lilmuslimena `edan
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of this day, which You have decided to be feast for the Muslims,

lines.arabic: وَلِمُحَمّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِه ذُخْراً وَمَزِيداً
lines.transliteration: wa limuhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi dhukhran wa mazedan
lines.english: And to be safety and increasing honor for Muhammad—peace of Allah be upon him and his Household—

lines.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلّيَ عَلَى مُحَمّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمّدٍ
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: (I beseech You) that You may send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

lines.arabic: وَأَنْ تُدْخِلَنِي فِي كُلّ خَيْرٍ أَدْخَلْتَ فِيهِ مُحَمّداً وَآلَ مُحَمّدٍ،
lines.transliteration: wa an tudkhilany fe kulli khayrin adkhalta fehi muhammadan wa ala muhammadin
lines.english: And You may include me with every item of goodness with which You have included Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

lines.arabic: وَأَنْ تُخْرِجَنِي مِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ أَخْرَجْتَ مِنْهُ مُحَمّداً وَآلَ مُحَمّدٍ
lines.transliteration: wa an tukhrijany min kulli su‘in akhrajta minhu muhammadan wa ala muhammadin
lines.english: And that You save me from any item of evil from which You have saved Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
May Your blessings be upon him and upon them.

lines.arabic: اللّهُمّ إِنّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادُكَ الصَّالِحُونَ،
lines.transliteration: allahumma inne as’aluka khayra ma sa’alaka `ibaduka alssalihuna
lines.english: O Allah: I pray You for the best of all that for which Your righteous servants have prayed You,

lines.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِمَّا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ عِبَادُكَ المُخْلِصُون.
lines.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika mimma ista`adha minhu `ibaduka mukhlisoon
lines.english: And I seek Your protection against all that against which Your sincere servants have asked Your protection.
